messages:
sophie: Heads-up — planning an EU regional cutover DRY RUN during the Friday change window (Sat 02:00 UTC). Objective: validate rollback path, deploy-bot pin/unpin flow, release notes link, and end-to-end alerts.
kevin: SGTM. Want to run the rollback dryrun earlier to validate runbooks. I can kick it off at 23:30 UTC tonight.
anya: Can you paste the minimal checklist we'll run? quick bullets ok.
miguel: We should also smoke the dedicated GPU pools (dedicated-01) and confirm autoscale behaves under canary CPU spike.
sophie: Checklist (minimal):
```
- confirm release-bot release_notes uploaded
- deploy-bot canary=true deploy to eu-west-1 (10% traffic)
- simulate error + trigger rollback path
- pin/unpin of model version via deploy-bot
- metric/alert validation: 5xx rate, latency p95, mem pressure
- confirm SLOs and rollback time < 5m
```
deploy-bot: @sophie scheduled dry-run for 2026-06-13T02:00:00Z. Canary traffic: 10%. To run earlier use `deploy-bot dryrun now --region eu-west-1`.
release-bot: Release notes uploaded -> https://internal/releases/2026-06-eu-cutover (sha: a1b2c3). Please verify changelog & customer-impact section.
oncall-sre: If we're doing a dryrun tonight, I need the rollback runbook link and the command to execute rollback in prod-sim.
kevin: rollback runbook -> https://wiki/runbooks/rollback-eu-cutover. Command (prod-sim):
```
./ops rollback --target eu-west-1 --version v3.4.1 --dry-run
```
kevin: Running dry-run now to validate logs.
kevin: Output: "rollback simulation complete: all hooks executed, canary traffic drained, alerting hooks fired" :white_check_mark:
oncall-sre: Awesome. Can you paste the quick logs for the alert hooks?
kevin: snippet: `ALERT_TRIGGER:latency_p95>800ms;hook:notify-oncall;status:ok`
jen: From PM side — no customer-facing changes expected. We'll post a status note to customers in case we flip traffic.
ops-liaison: I'll draft the customer note and loop legal for EU regions.
anya: One ask — ensure KV cache invalidation path is exercised; last time it didn't clear and blocked rollback.
miguel: I'll run cache invalidate test during canary. Adding `cache:flush --region eu-west-1 --prefix models/v3` to dryrun.
sophie: Can everyone with approval rights add reactions when they sign off? Need final pin owners: @kevin (rollback lead), @miguel (infra), @anya (platform).
lucas: Quick monitoring query for the dryrun — `sum(rate(http_requests_total{region="eu-west-1"}[1m])) by (status)`; watching spike in 5xx.
kevin: all approvals: :thumbsup: :rocket:
miguel: ready :heavy_check_mark:
anya: ready — will run cache invalidation step.
jen: PM sign-off :white_check_mark:
sophie: Great. Plan: dryrun tonight 23:30 UTC, main DRY RUN Sat 02:00 UTC during change window. If any blocker during dryrun we abort and reconvene in #eng-releases. Thanks all :pray:
deploy-bot: Dry-run executed (simulated) by kevin at 3177770020. Logs: https://logs.internal/3177770020
sophie: Confirmed — dryrun succeeded end-to-end. Leaving the scheduled main run as planned. Please keep phone oncall for the window.
ops-liaison: I'll send the customer advisory (internal draft) in 15m.
lucas: I'll standby on dashboards. :eyes:
